channel_title: Juan Carlos Gómez Psicólogo y Astrólogo
core_themes: Humanistic & Psychological Astrology, Jungian Shadow Work & Traumas, Planetary Transits (Pluto, Saturn, Chiron), Interpersonal Relationship Dynamics
narrative_style: Clinical, instructional, and deeply compassionate. Integrates analytical depth of analytical psychology with astrological symbolism.
target_audience: Individuals seeking psychological self-discovery, emotional trauma healing, and deeper astrological understanding of relationship dynamics.
high_performance_driver_patterns: High-urgency, emotion-driven titles addressing specific psychological pains and major planetary transits (e.g., 'El poder de las palabras para sanar traumas ocultos').

core_themes: Astrological Relationship Synastry, Karmic Romantic Bonds & Soul Connections, Venus & Mars Interpersonal Transits, Emotional Healing in Couples
